ipmi_addr.description: Hostname or IP address of the remote IPMI BMC interface (e.g., '192.168.1.10'). Required.

ipmi_user.description: Username to authenticate with the IPMI BMC. Must have sufficient privileges. Required.

ipmi_pass.description: Password for the IPMI user. DEPRECATED — prefer using ipmi_passfile for security. Leave empty if using passfile.

ipmi_passfile.description: Absolute path to a file containing only the IPMI password (recommended for secure credential storage).

ipmi_privilege_level.description: IPMI privilege level required to perform fencing operations (e.g., 'OPERATOR', 'ADMINISTRATOR'). Must match user capabilities.

ipmi_interface_type.description: IPMI interface type: 'lan' (unencrypted RMCP), 'lanplus' (encrypted RMCP+), or 'serial'. Use 'lanplus' for security.

ipmi_timeout.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for an IPMI command response before timing out.

ipmi_retries.description: Number of times to retry an IPMI operation after failure.

ipmi_cipher_suite.description: Optional numeric cipher suite ID for RMCP+ (e.g., '3' for AES-CBC-128). Leave blank to use default.

ipmi_kg_key.description: Optional 20-byte hex string of K_g key for OEM OEM-specific RMCP+ authentication. Leave blank if not used.

ipmi_lan_channel.description: Optional numeric LAN channel (e.g., '1' or '2') if BMC uses non-default channel. Omit to auto-detect.

ipmi_tls_disable_cert_check.description: If true (not recommended), disable TLS certificate validation for lanplus connections (e.g., with self-signed certs).
